title: worker.appraise: refuse compiled modules; certify unreachable changes only by mutation fallback or a founder oracle
problem: On #196 (d35d92a5) a worker could close a mission with corrupted source in two ways: a planted unchecked-hash .pyc that the tests ran instead of the source, and a change (alias, import) the mutation adversary could not reach, certified by a test that only imports its subject.
baseline: d35d92a5: both corrupted patches ACCEPTED, mission achieved (probed through the Body path).

alternatives.name: Proposed: refuse compiled paths in the patch + fallback mutation tier + fail closed when unmeasured unless a founder oracle passed
alternatives.description: Small checks in the existing appraiser and evidence_strength; no new subsystem.
disadvantages: Honest changes with no mutable site need a founder acceptance test
Refuses legitimate native extensions in a patch

alternatives.name: Run acceptance with PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX pointing at an empty directory
alternatives.description: Python then ignores __pycache__ beside the source.
disadvantages: Does not stop sourceless .pyc or native extensions
Hides the attempt instead of recording it
alternatives.revival_evidence: a founder repository that must ship bytecode

alternatives.name: Keep unmeasured as adequate; rely on discrimination
disadvantages: An import-only test certifies any alias

alternatives.name: Restrict inline-constant mutation (PIT INLINE_CONSTS off) or score per line
disadvantages: Measured: does not remove 76ebb40's rejection; 'none' adds 53e0b3e
alternatives.revival_evidence: a held-out replay where it removes a rejection without losing a true finding

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Workers can close missions on code the founder never saw.

roles.position: A closed mission must mean the delivered source does what was asked; this restores that for two cheap attacks.
material_concerns: Do not block honest string-only work

roles.position: Checks live in the one appraiser and the one evidence module; no new authority or registry.
material_concerns: judge gains an oracle flag the caller must set

roles.position: Both probes reproduce on the parent and fail closed here; ten appraisal mutants caught.
material_concerns: A test checking callable(sub) still kills the -> None mutant
Other import-time hooks (.pth in site-packages) are outside the clone, not reachable by a worker

roles.position: Appraisal cost unchanged where primary operators reach the change; fallback only adds runs where none ran before.
material_concerns: Orders for import-only changes now need explicit acceptance tests

roles.position: Negative result of the policy experiment recorded with its measurement hazard; earlier false-rejection reading corrected.
material_concerns: Replayed commits are agent-authored; small sample

counterevidence.finding: false as stated: with ordinal mutants removed the sample lands on other untested changed lines; still REJECTED under every policy

pass_1.intended_outcome: worker.appraise ACCEPTS only when evidence tells the delivered source from a wrong one.

advantages.amplified_value: Every code_change mission and every Genesis build judged by worker.appraise inherits it

disadvantages.statement: Honest import-only changes are rejected without a founder oracle
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Finding names the remedy; fallback tier measures strings and bindings first

disadvantages.statement: Legitimate native extensions in a patch are refused
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Compiled code is not reviewable source; stated in the module

disadvantages.statement: Fallback '-> None' is killed by trivially weak tests
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Residual stated; founder oracle closes it

comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: refuse compiled paths + fail closed on unmeasured
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: cache-prefix isolation plus richer mutation operators

rejected_alternatives.name: Constant-policy switch
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: measured: no rejection removed, one added
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: held-out replay showing a net gain

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack the fallback's strength, the oracle flag's honesty, the restore step and the replay's validity.

new_weaknesses.statement: oracle=True whenever acceptance.tests is non-empty, even if the oracle does not exercise the change
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Oracle files are sealed at the base and authored by the founder; judging what they test is the founder's call, stated in the module

new_weaknesses.statement: Replay could misreport survivors through stale bytecode
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Found and fixed in the harness (PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE); product runs already set it

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: 0 of 2 honest unreachable dev commits rejected after the fallback
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: first founder mission rejected with 'name an acceptance test'

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: no GREG order so far delivers native code
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: an order that must deliver an extension
a probe that passes the fallback with a callable-only test

pass_2.final_design: compiled_modules refusal with base restore; _Fallback tier; unmeasured adequate only with a founder oracle; shipped operators retained.

residual_risks.risk: Mutation sampling may still miss the semantics that matter (e.g. O_EXCL in b2475087)

dissent.handling: No dissent; D1 accepted with an owner and trigger.

migration_plan: Additive checks; no data migration. Orders for unreachable changes add an acceptance test.
kill_criteria: An honest change pinned by its tests is rejected only because of the fallback tier
A compiled path in a patch still reaches an acceptance run
review_trigger: Integrator intake, review findings or the held-out replay result
